title: kithd: startup sequence
description: Rewrite main.rs to wire all modules: (1) logging::init_logging() first; (2) Config::from_env(); (3) fs::create_dir_all(data_dir) or exit with error; (4) LocalApiClient::new(ts_socket); (5) if no owner_id in config: call ts.status() and error (auto-detect is Phase 2 — require KITHD_OWNER_ID for Phase 1); (6) Store::open(db_path); (7) make_channel(64), store.set_events_tx(tx), Arc::new(Mutex::new(store)); (8) build dispatcher and AppState; (9) tls::make_tls_acceptor(cert_path, key_path) or exit with error; (10) listener::bind_tailnet_listeners(&ts, port) or exit with error; (11) build axum app with .into_make_service_with_connect_info(); (12) tokio::spawn(kith_peer::outbox_worker(store, PeerHttpClient::new(), owner_id)); (13) for each listener, spawn a tokio task that accepts TLS connections and passes them to axum; (14) serve with signal::shutdown_signal() as graceful shutdown. All fatal errors log at ERROR and exit with code 1 (no panic in production path).
